name: title-determinism
description: #37 Tier 2 acceptance: from the title snapshot (boot point "title", frame T = 1250), play one input script, then play it again from the same snapshot in a new core instance. Both runs must end at T + 732 in the same state: main RAM and picture, compared by hash inside the sandbox, reported only as match 1/0. The script moves the title cursor and presses Circle, then waits 10 s, so the end state includes whatever the game does next; no FF7 address is used or claimed.
